Reina, a fallen noble's second daughter, works tirelessly to support her family and seeks their love. Yet her life takes an unexpected turn when her desperate parents marry her off to a viscount she's never met to avoid financial ruin. But though she expects a harder life, Reina finds unexpected solace when she is welcomed by her caring in-laws. And then there is Felix, her charming husband-to-be, who has admired Reina from afar. As Reina navigates her new life, can she heal from the past and find the love she's always longed for in her new family?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: 売られた花嫁は義家族に溺愛される
ลูกสะใภ้ที่รัก

177094.description: Yoshida-san, the malnourished corporate slave, and Miku, the clumsy grim reaper who came from the underworld to extend her lifespan. The dining table where these two very different people gather is a messy, but somewhat gentle place. Will Yoshida-san be able to become "healthy"!? The mysterious communal life of a human and a reaper begins!

title.native: ごはんのおトモに、死神と！
title.romaji: Gohan no Otomo ni, Shinigami to!

177095.description:
Hikari runs a small inn deep in the mountains. There's a guy they like, who visits the inn every year. On the last summer before the inn closes for good, there is no other guest besides the man. After a few drinks, Hikari finally confides their feelings to him, and the drunken man begins to caress their body…

(Source: DLSite, translated)
synonyms: The Night of the Long Way Around

177096.description:
Being sexy can be mortifying, so who will be the first to tap out in this battle of flirtatious gazes between smitten seatmates Eguchi and Ikezawa?

(Source: VIZ Media)

Note: Originally self-published, the manga got licensed by Shogakukan and started being published on Sunday Webry since June 17th, 2024. The original first chapter was republished with some changes, the subsequent chapters are being published without changes.

Tonari no Seki no Yatsu ga Eroi me de Mitekuru Hanashi
隣の席の奴がエロい目で見てくる話

title.native: となりの席のヤツがそういう目で見てくる
title.romaji: Tonari no Seki no Yatsu ga Souiu Me de Mitekuru

177100.description:
I’m Taishi Aoba, a fifth-grader who's popular and good at everything. As a kind hero figure, I need a tragic heroine by my side. That tragic heroine’s name is Ema Akatsuki. I thought everything would go well if I asked the poor girl out, but things didn't turn out as planned...

(Source: Manga Plus)

title.native: ヒロトくんはヒーローになり
お姉さんエルフは一線を越えたい

1. Cerulean Blue (セルリアン・ブルー)
2. Silver Hill no Nichiyoubi (シルバーヒルの日曜日)

7. Gogo no Hidamari (午後の陽だまり)

177105.description: Contains a brand new Kemo Fujin side story and 7 bonus pages of setting materials. Originally self-published and released at Comitia 138.

title.native: オレと恋愛してみませんか
title.romaji: Ore to Renai Shite Mimasen ka

177108.description:
Dr. Lee Sun-Woo is one of the nation's finest scientists, who dreams of a world where every human (including men) can conceive a child. Unfortunately, he eventually has to shut down his project. During his now ample free time, he happens to run into an old crush, a friend's older brother, Eun-Gyo. In any other world, this situation may be normal, but not when Sun-Woo's (extremely vocalized) desire is for Eun-Gyo's sperm!

(Source: Lezhin US)

177109.description:
As soon as U-Ju becomes the student council president, all the female students who were supposed to help him resign. By chance, he discovers a tablet in a warehouse that can control women, and uses the power of the tablet to take revenge... [Fuck all the female students by command.]

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)
synonyms: The Student Council President’s Hidden Task Is the (Sexual) Development of Female Students

title.native: 학생회장의 숨겨진 업무는 여학우들의 성(性)적 향상입니다
title.romaji: Haksaenghoejangui Sumgyeojin Eommuneun Yeohagudeurui Seongjeok Hyangsangimnida

177110.description:
In the Amami Islands, a small humanoid species known as Havilans (or Butterfly People) has been discovered. To prevent their extinction, they are protected by humans, and breeding mates are assigned to them. Oshino, a young Havilan lad, harbors feelings for his designated mate Mai, but their relationship hasn’t progressed. One day, however, Oshino learns the truth about Mai’s real feelings and…

(Source: MANGA MILLION)

title.english: Record of Havila War: Tales of the Butterfly

177114.description:
The setting is a modern world populated with beast-people, ruled by the law of the jungle. Twenty-year-old Yu Wenxi is a wolf-woman who stands at the top of the food chain. She fought her way to the top with her bare hands with a fierce attitude and no respect for the weak. Until one day, when her stepsister dumped a fox cub on her. From then on, the wild wolf turned into a gentle guard dog. She vowed to raise the crybaby cub to become a good student and a good citizen! However, the fox-girl's good-girl appearance hides a dark side.

Little Fox: "Sister, I've been a good girl, can you… do something nice for me?" (Blinking back tears)

Now that the crybaby fox cub is all grown up, her first order of business is to find and capture the gray wolf that abandoned her. She'll chain that wolf to her territory, and never let her escape…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes five extras.
synonyms: Miss Wolf and Her Fox Sister

title.native: 狼小姐和她的狐狸妹妹
title.romaji: Lang Xiaojie He Ta De Huli Meimei

177115.description:
Jiang Li, after crossing over, discovered that he possessed no special abilities, so he had no choice but to diligently cultivate. Five hundred years later, he finally became the strongest man in the Nine Provinces. Suddenly, a System appeared, offering to help him to go from a beginning cultivator to becoming the strongest in the Nine Provinces.

Jiang Li stared incredulously at the System's first mission: “Defeat your cousin (sixth-level cultivator).”

“This System is running a little late, isn't it?”

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)
synonyms: Counterattacking System Available at the Grand Ascension Stage
Only in the Mahayana Period Does the Counterattack System Exist

177116.description:
Hana Usagi is a first-year high school girl. She lives with her stepbrother, Yui, in a house known as "The Mansion of Tragedy."

She thinks of herself as just an ordinary schoolgirl.... but every night, she takes a "secret walk" looking to avenge her parents' murder. Meanwhile, her stepbrother keeps begging for a taste of her "blood."

Is it scary... to have your blood sucked?
Or... does it feel good?

Humans and vampires, love and mystery intertwine, in a bloodsucking dark fantasy!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

177117.description:
Chiaki is good-looking, academically excellent, athletic, and born into a well-off family with two beautiful sisters. He leads a smooth sailing life, but he still has one problem. He's not popular with girls, and has never once been in love! He vowed to make a fresh start in high school and spend his days being pampered by girls. The morning after making this vow, Chiaki wakes up to find that he himself has turned into a girl.

He is shocked to find an unfamiliar face staring back at him in the mirror, but when he looks again, he sees a very cute girl in the reflection. He immediately goes to show off his new look to his twin sister Kaede, who happens to be very popular with the girls, but there is also something very strange happening to her…

(Source: Young Animal, translated)
synonyms: My First Love Is Too Embarrassing to Tell Anyone

title.native: 私の初恋は恥ずかしすぎて誰にも言えない
title.romaji: Watashi no Hatsukoi wa Hazukashisugite Dare ni mo Ienai

177118.description:
Maki Okochi, in her mid-30s, has been without a man for about 10 years. She knows that she's been neglecting herself as a woman in many ways. But she's suppose to be mature enough to not just fall head-over-heels for just anyone, or so she thought, until she met the young man living next door…?

(Source: officeYOU, translated)
synonyms: The Man Next Door Often Eats
The Man Next Door Eats Too Much

title.romaji: Tonari no Otoko wa Yoku Taberu

177119.description:
Han Liee, who didn't do well in the college entrance examination, got frustrated in love, and achieved nothing after graduation, prayed to God that if he could start over again...

With the advent of the consumption system, he actually went back to the year when he was 18! No superior skills? He could upgrade his skills with points! Too average in appearance? He could shape his face with points! After the time travel, he taught a rich guy who picked on him a lesson and captured the hearts of some popular pretty girls... Let's see how Han Liee would rise from the ashes and become a top-tier man after his rebirth.

(Source: Webnovel)
synonyms: I Regressed to Level up Instead of Being a Simp

title.native: 重生不当舔王，我独自氪金升级
title.romaji: Chongsheng Bu Dang Tianwang, Wo Duzi Kejin Shengji

177130.description:
Kaoruko has lived 24 years of her life completely uninterested in men in the 3D world. Being an obsessed otome game fan, she only cares for her 2D men in the 2D world! That is, until her parents force her to go to a matchmaking meeting with a man who looks exactly like her favorite character?! She agrees to the marriage right away! But...he doesn't! Unlike the prince of her video game, Tsukasa is unfriendly and cold, giving Kaoruko a reality whiplash. But for the first time, her heart moved for a real, 3D man... so her only option now is to "conquer" the Tsukasa route and have her happy ending!

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.english: A Fangirl's Guide to Learning How to Date 3D Men
title.native: 私の“王子様”が三次元化したのですが　～オタクな私と同棲＆リアル恋愛しています！？
title.romaji: Watashi no "Ouji-sama" ga Sanjigen-ka Shita no desu ga: Otaku na Watashi to Dousei & Real Renai Shiteimasu!?

177131.description:
Inexperienced in love, an otome-game fanatic, her ideal man is a game character! Kaoruko Tojo is a nerdy young woman without many redeeming qualities. She is set up on a blind date with the handsome Tokiori Tsukasa, who is like a three-dimensional version of her favorite in-game prince! Even though Tokiori refuses to accept her proposal, Kaoruko is determined to confess her feelings for him, and in a strange turn of events, they end up living together with the promise of marriage! As their relationship gradually changes, he wonders if Kaoruko likes him for who he really is? It's a relationship full of twist and turns, the exciting life together of an otaku girlfriend and a tsundere "prince."

(Source: J-Publishing, translated)

title.native: 私の“王子様”が三次元化したのですが　～オタクな私と同棲＆リアル恋愛しています！？
title.romaji: Watashi no "Ouji-sama" ga Sanjigen-ka Shita no desu ga: Otaku na Watashi to Dousei & Real Renai Shiteimasu!?

title.native: 特『刀剣乱舞-花丸-』～雪月華～

177134.description:
Goryeo prince Jin Yuseong is a martial arts hero, but after losing his comrades, his loneliness drives him to walk through the palace's magic gate for a fresh start. Arriving in modern-day Seoul, he becomes an unexpected hero in a gate break mission, drawing the attention of the Safe Gate organization, who protect civilians from the gates. Eager to escape recruitment into SG, Yuseong disguises as the high school nephew of a former comrade, but will this be enough to outrun his fighter past?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Heavenly Demon Who Doesn’t Want to Level Up
The Heavenly Demon Lord Who Doesn't Want to Level Up

title.english: The Heavenly Demon Doesn't Want to Level Up

177135.description:
Justine, a daughter of a fallen noble family, works as a seamstress named Elise at the Royal Palace while hiding her true identity. On the day of the royal wedding, the Princess’ Royal necklace was stolen! After a series of unfortunate events, Justine was falsely accused by the crowd of stealing the necklace. Just when Justine thought there was no escape from being labeled a criminal, Lord Shimeon De Castille, the King’s nephew, stepped in to help her. He offered to keep Justine at his mansion until all suspicions are cleared. Justine knows that Lord Shimeon is only being kind because of his good nature, but for some reason, she can’t help but have feelings for him. However, her toxic relationship from the past tells Justine it’s better not to fall in love again. So, it’s only natural that she keeps her distance from Lord Shimeon, right?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: เลดี้ผู้อาภัพกับดยุกสีชาด
Die eisblaue Dame und der purpurne Herzog

title.english: The Lost Lady and the Crimson Duke
title.native: 見捨てられた令嬢と深紅の公爵
title.romaji: Misuterareta Reijou to Shinku no Koushaku

177136.description:
Justine, a down-on-her-luck noblewoman, had her engagement annulled and exiled from her estate after she was falsely accused of stealing her fiancé's family heirlooms. Four years later, she is once again falsely accused of theft at the royal court, where she has been working as a seamstress under an assumed name. Justine was about to give up hope when she is rescued by the king's nephew, Duke Simeon. But for some reason, he insists on keeping her at his mansion until she is cleared of all suspicion?

(Source: Sankosha, translated)

title.native: 濡れ衣を着せられまして 見捨てられた令嬢と深紅の公爵
title.romaji: Nureginu wo Kiseraremashite: Misuterareta Reijou to Shinku no Koushaku

177137.description: Shungicu Uchida tells the story of building her own home.

title.native: 俺物語! 雪山ミステリー!?の巻
title.romaji: Ore Monogatari!! Yukiyama Mystery!? no Maki

synonyms: The Shape of Your Love Side Stories

177141.description:
The bullied loser Kim Jae-Hyeok receives 'Top 1 Fighting Tutoring'!

Kim Jae-Hyeok is a high school student who has been living in despair under the torment of bullies. He's good at studying, but he'd rather be good at fighting.

Then, as if by fate, a 'fighting tutor' comes into his life!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: ติวเตอร์ต่อสู้มือฉมัง

177142.description:
Mu-Gyeol Cha, a high-school student, is consistently bullied by a group of delinquents at school. Elsewhere, Mu-Gyeol, a mixed martial artist, has been set up to be left paralyzed and meets his demise. Two different lives are at their ends, but somehow, they both end up living on in the same body. Will they succeed in finding justice, and climb their way back up to achieve their dreams?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
synonyms: หมาหัวเน่าเก๋าเกินไป

title.native: この愛は、国王陛下のご命令じゃない ～おひとりさま希望の令嬢ですが、不仲な騎士が離してくれません！～
title.romaji: Kono Ai wa, Kokuou Heika no Go Meirei ja Nai: Ohitori-sama Kibou no Reijou desu ga, Funaka na Kishi ga Hanashite Kuremasen

title.native: 攻略対象キャラが全員HENTAIな乙女ゲームに転生したのでもうダメです。
title.romaji: Kouryaku Taishou Chara ga Zenin HENTAI na Otome Game ni Tensei Shita node Mou Dame desu

177152.description:
“Why should we care about free-to-play players?”

Seo Sa-hyuk, a planner who neglected gameplay and focused only on monetization elements, has now fallen victim to his own greed for making money, working tirelessly through the night until he succumbed to overwork. In his unfortunate situation, he wakes up once again.

“This place is just like the game I used to create…!!”

The demonic planner who tormented gamers is now experiencing the consequences he sowed, a story of redemption and transformation begins!

(Source: Naver, Translated)
synonyms: Was Manager Seo Disposed of as an Industrial Accident?

title.romaji: Kyuushou Kouhino Yarinaoshi: Fukushuu ya Chouai wa Nozomimasen

synonyms: The Demon Queen Can't Defeat Yuusha-kun.

title.native: 女魔王様はゆうしゃくんを倒せない。
title.romaji: Onna Maou-sama wa Yuusha-kun wo Taosenai.
Hana no Daichi ni Hikari Furu

177156.description:
"By any chance, are you psychic, miss?" I, Kensaku Serusumi, am a part-time worker and unmotivated slacker. Not exactly something to be proud of. When I first started this job, I thought "An ability trading business seems too shady, I should quit soon." But people involved with psychic abilities tend to be pretty eccentric, which I find a bit entertaining.

Psychic abilities - referred to as supernatural powers or secret rites - are strange powers that manifest from people's desires and eventually disappear, like temporary miracles. They're not exactly rare, but not something everyone can freely obtain either. That's why those without abilities all say - "I want one too." If there are people who want them, then a business opportunity arises. The ability trading business was established to connect those who want to sell abilities and those who want to buy them.

The Hishoku Shokai I work for is one such ability trading company. The store is an old building in a corner of Saitama. Just the manager and I, a part-timer, work there. Still small in scale, but we work day and night dreaming of future success.

"Well then... Shall I go search for an ability holder for our cute but useless manager?"

177157.description:
Landon forced Zayden to go from Alpha to Omega. Zayden endured the pain, the rejection, and finally walked away after the divorce. Only when he was gone did Landon realize... he’d made the biggest mistake of his life.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Qian Fu You You You Xiang Fu Hun Le

177158.description:
Hidaka Akira is a high school boy who prefers solitude. He avoids the hustle and bustle of the classroom to eat lunch alone, but there is someone who likes to invade his private space. It's Chiyo Tsukimine, the beautiful girl at the top of the social pyramid. Tsukimine calls out Akira and demands that he "do his thing." What does she want him to do, that requires him to take off his shirt…?

(Source: Comic Gardo, translated)

177161.description:
"No one in their right frickin' mind would fall for you!"

Matsuda and his rival Kato belong to the sales department at Toto First Bank's head office, where the competition is cutthroat for its elite employees. But when Matsuda is in a drunken stupor one night, the two end up going at it...on his own bed! And the next morning, Kato kneels on one knee and proposes!!! Matsuda, who's always been straight, refuses to accept that the two have slept, so there's absolutely no way he'd develop feelings for the likes of Kato...right? Right?! When passion and stubborn pride are pitted against one another, which will prevail? Find out in the epic conclusion to this battle for love!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: If You Love Me, Be All Over Me
title.native: 俺が好きなら媚びてみろ
キャロット&スティック

177165.description:
Bombshell angel descends! ❤

(Source: FAKKU)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2018-04

177167.description:
Deep beneath the ocean lies the Alabaster Sea Kingdom, where its king, Taerang, faces a deadly curse. Born without a heart, he must steal one from a woman who truly loves him or die on his 25th birthday. Having given up all hope as his cursed body convulses at any woman's touch, everything changes when a mysterious woman named Sollu appears. Now, the arrogant king must race against time to win her heart before it's too late!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Pure Heart of a Monster

177168.description: Isekai comedy about a die-hard metalhead who got electrocuted during his own metal band's farewell gig. He finds himself transported to a fantasy world filled with everything true metal fans can only dream about ranging from dragons to werewolves. Now this metalhead is determined to bring peace to this new world with his burning metal spirit!

177169.description:
There's a me that I do not know—

Ruka Shinozuka is a single woman with a history of broken engagements. She has nightmares every night, and when she wakes up, her body is covered with bruises and semen… Possessed by butterflies that run wild with dark desire, the woman began to lewdly seek out men. Tonight, too, the butterflies' mad party begins… This nightmare without end…

(Source: FEEL Comics, translated)

177170.description:
"Kill me, as you promised."

When her twin sister Leyla, the Holy Maiden, suddenly disappears one day, the ordinary Elena finds herself having to marry Crown Prince Kyle, a man infamous for his ruthlessness, in her stead. After a dreadful marriage ceremony, Kyle demands that a certain promise be fulfilled, to Elena’s confusion.

(Source: Manta)

177171.description:
Short stories filled with the bittersweet emotions of young love that will surely touch your heart!

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)
synonyms: The World with Only You and Me

177172.description:
A high school girl is in dire straits, with no money, nothing to eat, and no place to stay. Kanda Issei, who works at a game company, reaches out to this girl, Miu, mostly out of pure kindness, but also maybe a bit of ulterior motives. A "girl you can't leave alone" who exudes a seductive charm that is child-like yet very adult. What will this girl do to the life of an ordinary man…!?

(Source: Big Comic Bros, translated)

title.native: RoOT/ルート オブ オッドタクシー

177176.description:
When Cedric Reid finds himself in a parallel universe full of malevolent beings and comes into possession of a mystical notebook that has the power to turn whatever is written in it into reality, he decides to use it to punish the bad and absorb the powers of other supernatural entities. He later joins an elite group of special agents on a continuing mission to rid the world of evil.

(Source: WebComics)
synonyms: 俺は都市伝説で怪異と戦う

title.romaji: Wo, Chuang Zao Le Dushi Chuanshuo!

177178.description:
A love story that lasts longer than the principal's speech?
At a boring school entrance ceremony, a fateful encounter…!?

(Source: Hana to Yume, translated)

Note: Originally published in Hana to Yume 2024 vol. 9.

177181.description:
Souta, a high school student, has been hopelessly crushing on his childhood friend Chika for years. Afraid of ruining their close bond, he's kept his feelings hidden. But when Souta suspects Chika might be interested in getting a girlfriend, his patience runs out, and he decides to finally confess. Just as he's about to blurt it out, Chika stumbles upon a rather...unexpected object left behind by Souta's dad and they end up using it together!

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
177181.hashtag: #きっかけがこれでもいいですか

title.native: きっかけがこれでもいいですか？
title.romaji: Kikkake ga Koredemo Ii desu ka?

177183.description: The story is about Haruka, a girl with low self-esteem who fails every job interview. One day Haruka meets Ria, a girl who works at a shisha bar who values cuteness more than anything else, in Kabukicho (a nightlife district of Shinjuku), and little by little, she finds herself changing her life, sucked in that shining but dark world.

177184.description:
Chikage is a beautiful girl in my class who is smart and well-behaved. She is my rival in school, but after school, she has another face. After school, she plays in the arcade with an innocent smile that would be unimaginable in class.

I try to make friends with Chikage on campus and play with her after school in order to get to know her better. It seems like we're getting closer to each other, until finally… Chikage confesses her feelings for me as we were leaving school!

I decide to accept her confession and I tell her how I feel on our way home from the arcade.

Just when I think Chikage is now my girlfriend, another girlfriend shows up!

(Source: Fantasia Bunko, translated)
synonyms: เป็น [แฟน] กับฝาแฝดทั้งสองคนเลยไหม?

title.native: 双子まとめて 『カノジョ』にしない？

177185.description:
This is a story of the simple life of the three bears: the panda bear, the black bear, and the polar bear.

(Source: Webtoon)
synonyms: San Zhi Xiong De Xiao Rizi

title.english: The Life of the Three Bears
title.romaji: San Zhi Xiong no Xiao Rizi

177186.description:
Chikage is a beautiful girl in my class who is smart and well-behaved. She is my rival in school, but after school, she has another face. After school, she plays in the arcade with an innocent smile that would be unimaginable in class.

I try to make friends with Chikage on campus and play with her after school in order to get to know her better at both places. We grow closer to each other, until finally… a heartwarming triangular love comedy begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: Why Don't You Make the Twins Your "Girlfriend" Together?

title.native: 双子まとめて『カノジョ』にしない？

177187.description:
Rene is a smart and beautiful high school girl who attracts everyone's attention. Her secret hobby is to pursue a "good sleep" in order to overcome her only weak point, her flat chest! Full of "tips for a good night's sleep!" This is the start of an authentic sleep comedy!

(Source: Comic FUZ, translated)

177188.description:
Who says a short king can’t find love? In fact, not only does Amane have an adorably cute girlfriend with a smile that lights up the whole world, she also happens to be the tallest person in class! It may be a challenge for these two goofballs to work around their height differences—especially since they’re keeping it on the down-low to avoid being teased about it—but with a positive attitude and a lotta love, this height-gap romantic comedy will leave you wanting more!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: My Girlfriend Is a Colossal Cutie
title.native: 僕の彼女はデッカワイイ

177189.description:
Bullying, neglect... a high school boy in the depth of despair. He commits the heinous crime of kidnapping his crush, Haruka, and holding her in confinement. But that is when he sees Haruka's own twisted nature…!

(Source: Comic Killa, translated)

title.native: 最下層の僕が奴隷を飼ったら―監禁観察日記―
title.romaji: Saikasou no Boku ga Dorei wo Kattara: Kankin Kansatsu Nikki

177190.description:
A story about a girl who desperately wants to fall in love and a boy who wants nothing to do with romance.

Note: Originally published in Margaret 2023 Issue No. 16.

title.native: だから 今日も恋を駆ける
title.romaji: Kakara Kyou mo Koi wo Kakeru

177192.description:
In a past life, the mountain goddess took in a quiet child, only to find that the little one didn't want to be her servant, but instead aspired to become her intimate companion! But fate played its cruel hand, turning the once inseparable pair into bitter enemies?

In this life, a cute, water-fearing mermaid happens upon an aloof beauty with no memories of her past. A chance kiss during their first meeting is just the start of their chaotic relationship. However, what had seemed to be a serendipitous meeting turns out to be a long-fated reunion with roots reaching deep into the past...

From lifetimes past to present, an obsessive love flourishes...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Taira is popular with his teammates, but he retired in the middle of his second year of high school, saying he wanted to become a police officer like his father. On her sixteenth birthday, Viscountess Mille-Feuille Forêt Noire, a member of a long-lived race called dragonkin, remembers her previous life as the murdered fiancée of Dragon Duke Vacherin. She immediately vows never to get involved with him again and aspires to live a peaceful life by hiding what she knows, but after a twist of fate or two...she soon winds up the Dragon Duke’s personal attendant! Past intrigue now begins to yield problems in the present. Who killed Mille-Feuille in her last life? How can she improve the lives of fellow dragonkin women? Is she in love with the Dragon Duke, or are her feelings just lingering attachment from their old romance? And how will this all affect her new relationship with her former fiancé? History may or may not repeat itself in this romantic fantasy!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

Just as everyone’s jaws hit the floor, a mysterious system appears and tells him, “Shock others to earn rewards!” From astonishing the Queen to shaking the entire world, Ning Tian begins an unstoppable rise that will leave everyone trembling!

One day, he overhears his crush comment, "Wouldn't he be the cutest if he was a girl?!" This makes him worry she doesn't even see him as a guy. Down in the dumps, he prays at the shrine next to his house in the hopes that he can still achieve young love. However, it seems there was a major misunderstanding, because when his prayer is answered, he winds up transformed into a girl! Thus begins Uesugi's gender-bent love triangle!

However, it is forbidden to have feelings of love or hate toward a student! Although he tries to treat him and the other students equally, it seems that Sono has feelings for Mr. Shinohara...! Gyeongseong, 1920—the early days of colonial Korea. When a young Japanese boy is found dead at a local school's lantern festival, fingers start to point towards Kim Mugyeong. Despite the mounting pressure, Mugyeong refuses to talk, forcing officers to search for information elsewhere. Just what secrets have these two boys been hiding, and why does Mugyeong refuse to talk? In the midst of tumultuous social and political conflicts, the youth are just trying to make do. And while they say that some flowers bloom in adversity, perhaps there are also some that are destined to remain unblossomed.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Popular manga artist Makoto Kobayashi talks candidly about his journey from before his debut to becoming a popular writer based on his own experiences...Isn't that a little different? You can learn the truth about manga artists from a know-how book, it's so easy to understand! The truth about the nihilistic and dandy K-sensei, and the many responsibilities and hardships he must shoulder as a manga artist. If I knew this, would I no longer be able to admire manga artists? Also includes an episode about the cat that was the model for Michael in the legendary masterpiece "What's Michael?"

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

177491.description:
Satoru Takeichi, also known as Ichigo, works at a sawmill. While working, he got into a mechanical problem and ended up having the first joint of his right little finger amputated. He and other employees searched for the cut off part, but couldn't find it. Ichigo goes straight to the hospital and receives treatment. However, when he returned to his apartment after being hospitalized for a few days, he found another version of him... From there, a strange shared life with another [Nigo] begins...

(Source: Coamix, translated)

Chihiro, his childhood friend, has always been like an older sister to him and is the woman Yuuto admires. She is already married, so he thinks he has to give up, but since they live in apartments next to each other, there are a lot of temptations. Chihiro is always defenseless and her actions are bold, so she always confuses Yuuto with her charm.
The latest app "for married women'' that was recommended to him is a dating site that matches with beautiful women in the neighborhood for sex purposes. Prompted by Chihiro, Yuuto ends up repeating his enchanting experience...

When Aoi shares that he’s been cast as the star in an upcoming movie being filmed in Hokkaido, Haruto is thrilled for his lover, yet sad at the prospect of spending three months apart. Only minutes after hearing the news, though, Haruto receives his own offer to fill-in as a hair and make-up artist for the same movie Aoi is starring in! Will they be able to keep their relationship a secret? Or will working in such close proximity expose their love to the world?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

177505.description:
After her sister’s engagement to the crown prince is broken off suddenly, tragedy strikes, and Lady Francette and her family lose all of their wealth and status. Left with nothing but her name and determination, Francette moves to the slums and ekes out a living selling homemade pastries. That’s when she meets an unlikely new friend named Wibble, a talking slime who introduces her to the one and only slime duke himself: Gabriel! To her surprise, the unusually stoic Gabriel soon asks for Francette’s hand in marriage--and she accepts. Now she must adapt to Triste and its eccentric people, and she soon finds herself breathing life into the strange but endearing backwater. What was once a marriage of convenience becomes something much more in time...and—of course—expect lots of slime!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

In a team meeting to come up with ideas for the band's channel, Rik proposes bringing Reo on and finally ends up meeting his long-time idol. After a post-filming dinner, Rik works up the courage to invite Reo to his place to chat with him some more, but the cute and kind Reo suddenly comes on to Rik… This is a love story between a cool and standoffish pop star who actually loves cute things and a cute but total bottom arts and crafts guy!

title.romaji: Elf no Genkai Shuuraku wo Zetsurin Chinpo de Sukuu Tanetsuke Haramase Harem

177522.description:
"Taste comes from the heart!" Shingo Kouzuki, a boy who aspires to become a first-class chef, experiments a thousand different tastes with his own guts and ingenuity! Finally, the first volume of a neo-gourmet manga that adds an extra flavor to the gourmet boom in pursuit of genuine deliciousness!

(Source: Trust Two, translated)

177523.description:
Eugene Pellivia, the youngest son of a legendary warrior family, is on the brink of death—until he’s visited by Pellin, the fabled Mage of Creation, and given a second chance at life. Determined to follow in the footsteps of the one who saved him, Eugene sets out to become a great mage and use his powers for good. But fate has other plans, and before long, he's drawn into the shadows of a darker world...

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Second Life is a Healing Life?

177527.description: The adventurer Zion, who possesses the "Translator" skill, the ability to understand the language of demons and animals, spends his days and nights on quests with his childhood friends in order to make the A-class party. However, he is suddenly kicked out of the party because his abilities are not useful in battle. Disappointed, Zion makes a new start as a solo adventurer, thanks to the encouragement of Angelina, the guild receptionist. Later, several races join Zion's party, including a female slime swordsman and half-demon whose skills were deemed useless, and form a party of outsiders who are later described as heroes.

title.native: 追放された俺が外れギフト『翻訳』で最強パーティー無双！～魔物や魔族と話せる能力を駆使して成り上がる～
title.romaji: Tsuihosareta Ore ga Hazure Gift "Honyaku" de Saikyo Party Muso! Mamono Yamazoku to Hanaseru Noryoku wo Kushi Shite Nariagaru

title.native: 追放された俺が外れギフト『翻訳』で最強パーティー無双！～魔物や魔族と話せる能力を駆使して成り上がる～
title.romaji: Tsuihosareta Ore ga Hazure Gift "Honyaku" de Saikyo Party Muso! Mamono Yamazoku to Hanaseru Noryoku wo Kushi Shite Nariagaru

177529.description:
Hyeseo and Seoha were only supposed to be tutor and tutee. But why are they becoming something more...?

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Machi ni Ame no Furu Gotoku

177531.description:
The world changed one day. In the world of humans, the devils showed up. No one knows how creatures from different dimensions managed to appear in the human world. Cain was abandoned by his parents and raised by Guseul, the ace of Evil Hunter. During his mission, he met a little girl with blue hair, a mixed creature of a human and a beast.

(Source: DAYcomics)

177532.description:
Noah is the eldest son from a noble family known for their magical prowess. As such, his father expects him to possess a Talent for elemental attack magic. But during his appraisal, it was revealed that not only couldn't he use magic, but he had a particularly useless Talent—"Translation.” Yet, no one could have guessed that this astonishing ability has the power to change the world!

(Source: Manga UP! Global)
synonyms: 【번역】의 재능으로 나만이 세계를 개변할 수 있는 건에 대해

title.english: Only My Undesirable Translation Talent Can Change the World
title.native: 【翻訳】の才能で俺だけが世界を改変できる件　～ハズレ才能【翻訳】で気付けば世界最強になってました～
title.romaji: "Honyaku" no Sainou de Ore Dake ga Sekai wo Kaihen Dekiru Ken: Hazure Sainou "Honyaku" de Kizukeba Sekai Saikyou ni Nattemashita

177533.description:
Tiny Ikki Sakurai and handsome and athletic Ryo Takizawa are best friends since childhood. Drawn to the world where big money flies wildly, they both aspire to become horse racing jockeys. After enrolling in a horse racing school, the two will discover whether they truly hold any talent for racing...

(Source:J-Comic Terrace, translated)

title.native: オーバーロード＜新＞世界編

177535.description:
Seong Mi-In is living an enviable life, happily married to a handsome, rich, and loving husband. Then one day, she witnesses her husband's strange behavior, and her seemingly perfect marriage begins to show cracks as doubts grow in her mind.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

177536.description:
While getting a nighttime snack, the illustrator Xin Xin runs into Yin Yin, a rich girl drunk and wasted on the street. Xin Xin takes her home, cleans her up, and even makes her a bowl of hot-and-sour noodle soup when she wakes up hungry... After some back-and-forth, Xin Xin ends up letting the "homeless" Yin Yin stay, as she needs a new roommate anyway. Bit by bit, the beautiful and outgoing Yin Yin chips away the icy facade of the serious and independent Xin Xin...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
synonyms: 入味 この娘と食卓を囲む日から
Ruwei: Kono Musume to Shokutaku o Kakomu hi Kara

177537.description:
There are two people who are always in the student council room. Me, the president of the student council, and Namida Kurishita, the vice president. At first, there were other officers, but they all stopped showing up because the VP takes care of all the work. She is usually a beautiful and well-behaved honor student, but... she likes to tease me in strange ways when we're alone!?

Girls' love gone wild under the guise of ladylike behavior...!
This is a slightly naughty romantic comedy that takes place in secret in the student council room!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)
synonyms: The Main and Favorite Duties of Ms. Kurishita

177538.description:
Upon being reborn, Bai Man is singularly focused on killing the tyrant Emperor and claiming the throne for herself. In her quest for power, she decides she must first win over the Grand Marshall Zhou Rong. But the first time they meet, Zhou Rong slams Bai Man to the bed and asks her if she remembers the pleasures from last night? Oh no! That cool lady general turns out to be a crazed yandere in private!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.romaji: Jiao Yang Le Ge Feng Pi Mei Ren Er

177539.description:
I feel like I've forgotten someone important…

Yuuma Kurose, a lonely boy who can see ghosts, is plagued by a recurring nightmare. As if drawn by some unseen force, he returns to the hometown that haunts his dreams. There, he meets a boy named Kaito, who is surrounded by terrifying spirits. "I'll always protect you," Kaito says with an unexpectedly serious look. But the moment they touch, the spirits surrounding Kaito suddenly possess Yuuma…?! A cool, obsessive seme and a brave, unlucky uke. Their reunion stirs time, once frozen, into motion once more.

(Source: ShuCream, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.native: お憑かれさま、黒瀬くん

177540.description:
I, Itsumi Nakadera, have been living in an institution since my parents' death. Two years ago, when I was about to be adopted by a wealthy family, my grandfather Itsuki came looking for me, but frankly, I had no intention of going with some random old man I didn't know. The reason I changed my mind was because I was annoyed by the way my grandfather looked at me, as if I was some sort unusual creature. Since then, I've started living alone with my grandfather. He is a super-humanly quiet and unsociable man, but he always gives me advice on the various incidents that I come across...

A grandfather and his grandson team to up solve many mysteries together in this slice-of-life detective story!

(Source: Group Zero, translated)

title.romaji: Jii-san to Boku no Jiken Jou

title.native: 捨てられエルフさんは世界で一番強くて可愛い！
title.romaji: Suterare Elf-san wa Sekai de Ichiban Tsuyokute Kawaii!

177542.description:
The series is based on the works of H.P. Lovecraft, with a focus on the recurring character Randolph Carter in H.P. Lovecraft's works that Kadokawa states is modeled after Lovecraft himself.

(Source: Anime News Network)

Note: this includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: ランドルフ・カーターの物語
H.P. Lovecraft's The Unnamable and Other Stories About Dreamlands
H.P. Lovecrafts Das Unsagbare und Andere Geschichten

title.native: 名状しがたいもの ラヴクラフト傑作集

177543.description:
Karina Ichinose, gal fashionista, became a team manager because she loves baseball. Yuki Himemiya became a team manager because her boyfriend was on the team. Akane Nagisa became a team manager because she’s popular—despite not knowing the first thing about baseball!

Their managerial duties run the gamut—making rice balls for the team, cleaning lewd books(?) out of the clubroom, keeping a childhood friend company during his batting practice, and fretting over the team during their first nail-biting practice game! The bases are loaded with their exciting memories, and it’s time to play ball!

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: Mane Mane Nichi Nichi: Baseball Manager Everyday

177544.description:
A heart-pounding new life together with my "big sis cousin"!?

Masato Ooizumi just entered high school and he finds himself staying with a relative. Living there is his "big sister cousin" who's being way too close with him!? A slightly naughty, living together romcom begins under one roof!!
synonyms: I'll Be Spoiled by My Big Sis Cousin?

title.native: いとこのお姉ちゃんに甘えちゃう？

177545.description:
Koyama-sensei, a cram school teacher, has a secret romantic relationship with his student Kazumi. However, when Koyama meets Kazumi's older sister Yoko again, their relationship becomes complicated and entangled.

(Source: Shonengahosha, translated)

177546.description:
An ordinary college student, Lin Chao, accidentally got trapped in a game world. The system told her that she could only return to the real world if she wins over the female protagonist with maximum affection level. Unfortunately, the system assigned her the role of a villainess who would be eliminated by the protagonist right at the start.

“I better think of a way to get in with the protagonist, fast…”

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: Start by Becoming Your Strategy Target

title.native: 从成为你的攻略对象开始
title.romaji: Cong Chengwei Ni De Gonglüe Duixiang Kaishi

title.native: B級映映画にありがちな

177553.description:
I, a hack protagonist, am somehow captured by the evil final boss after maxing my charm stat?!

A tale of hacked (?!) infatuation between the strongest final boss (before his awakening) and a corporate slave that isekai'd into the game world!

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I'm a Powerful Main Character With a Cheat But Was Charmed and Joined the Dark Side, Where the Last Boss Attacked Me.
title.native: 「チート主人公」俺、魅力ステータスを完凸させたらなぜか闇堕ちラスボスに攻略されてます。
title.romaji: "Cheat Shujinkou" Ore, Miryoku Status wo Kantotsu Sasetara Nazeka Yamiochi Last Boss ni Kouryaku Saretemasu.

177554.description:
"This guy's my lover."

Ryou quit his job after his girlfriend invited him to join a pyramid scheme. One day, when he went to her home, he was worried about her and found a large number of Yakuza! Ryou is in a desperate situation when he is suspected of being in league with his girlfriend, who has absconded with money belonging to the Daikoku clan, and is rescued by Miyoshi, a junior high school classmate who happens to be a member of the Daikoku clan. The two end up living together as fake lovers until the situation cools down, but Miyoshi, who was supposed to be a good friend at the time, is quite cold toward Ryou...?

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: This false love carries the risk of death.

title.native: 命懸けダミーロマンス

177555.description:
I know the beautiful upperclassman's secret...

A youthful love story about a underclassman that doesn't know love and a cool beauty with some issues.

(Source: Kaiohsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: エレメンタリー・ファーストラブ

177556.description: Mugi (30), who’s out of work after her affair with her former superior was exposed, and Mame (23), the sassy-yet-cute owner of an izakaya that specializes in fermented food. These two, who seem to fail at everything, join forces to turn their empty izakaya into a popular hotspot! A down-to-earth romantic comedy and human drama about two people who keep moving forward, even when they make mistakes.

177557.description:
Fifteen years have passed since the end of the Great War. Thriving at the foot of the Imperial City of Flowers is the Haraiso Bar, run by the idiosyncratic Oharu-san. All sorts of customers come in each night, attracted by the delicious drinks and snacks.

(Source: Akitashoten, translated)

177561.description:
1979, the start of summer, faculty member of the science department Dr. Ukai is in the middle of a lecture when he first lays eyes on a visiting student from the humanities department, Toki. Toki is quiet, with a stoic air about him... and Ukai realizes he's completely fallen for him. However, ever since Ukai lost his long-time friend and secret lover Amakata, he's been hiding the fact that he is gay, keeping his feelings bottled up for no one to know of. One day, Ukai notices a student has been following him around and trying to get closer to him. As things start to become more than just a minor issue, Toki steps in to help. Ukai offers to take him out to eat as a way of thanking him, but it seems there's more to things than just a simple meal...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

177562.description:
Suzuno works at a major stationary company to help pay off her parents' debts, until Watakai, the heir of the company, learns about it.

"I can help you, if you marry me."

He proposes marriage to Suzuno and pay off her debts! Suzuno hesitates at first, but she is eventually drawn into a sweet newlywed life! Suzuno, who is inexperienced at love, doesn't know how to act towards him, which only unwittingly makes him feel more possessive of her...?

(Source: Berry's Bunko, translated)

title.native: 俺だけ見てろよ～御曹司といきなり新婚生活!?～
title.romaji: Ore dake Miteroyo: Onzoushi to Ikinari Shinkon Seikatsu!?

177563.description:
Iroha, a new office lady at a trading company, has never been in love, but she is about to enter into an arranged marriage. However, she still dreamed of having her first experience with someone she loves. So she boldly confesses her love to Kashiwagi, the most popular man at the company! They decide on a "limited-time lover's contract" and start slowly. Kashiwagi leads the nervous Iroha, who is nervous and stiff at first, gently through a first date. Although they are only suppose to be temporary lovers, Iroha can't stop herself from falling for him...!

(Source: Berry's Bunko, translated)
synonyms: Please tell me the love of adult

title.native: オトナの恋を教えてください
title.romaji: Otona no Koi wo Oshiete Kudasai

177564.description:
One day, Teru, a high school girl aspiring to become a manga artist, is hit by a truck and reincarnated into another world! She is made the slave of Sirius, a beautiful elf queen she meets in the other world, and begins a life of hardship... except... her orc coworker is the healing type, and the village's elves are cute? Eh? This seems like a pretty fun life...?

(Source: Houbunsha, translated)
synonyms: I Became a Slave in Another World (sob) and to make matters worse, My Master is a Black-Hearted Elf Queen! (But She’s Super Hot. (note: v. impt.)) I’m Pretty Useless, So I’m Getting Barked At Left, Right, and Centre, but the ORC I’m rooming with is full of good vibes, and the ELF in the Village is pretty cute too, so on the whole, I have to say that I’m actually quite enjoying myself here.

I was made a slave in a different world (I cry) and my master is an elf queen with a bad personality! (But she is very beautiful, and that's what's important.) I'm having a lot of fun, because my co-worker, an orc, is very healing, and the elves in my village are cute.

Watashi, Isekai de Dorei ni Sarechaimashita (Naki) Shikamo Goshujinsama wa Seikaku no Warui Elf no Joousama (demo Chou Bijin ← Koko Daiji): Munou Sugite Nonoshiraremakuru kedo Douryou no Orc ga Iyashi-kei da shi Sato no Elf wa Kawaii shi Kekkou Tanoshinderu Watashi desu.

Watashi, Isekai de Dorei ni Sarechaimashita (Naki) Shikamo Goshujin-sama wa Seikaku no Warui Elf no Joou-sama (demo Chou Bijin ← Koko Daiji) Munou Sugite Nonoshiraremakuru kedo Douryou no Orc ga Iyashikei da shi Sato no Elf wa Kawaii shi Kekkou Tanoshinderu Watashi desu.

title.native: 私、異世界で奴隷にされちゃいました（泣）しかもご主人様は性格の悪いエルフの女王様！（でも超美人←ここ大事）無能すぎて罵られまくるけど同僚のオークが癒やし系だし里のエルフは可愛いし結構楽しんでる私です。
title.romaji: Watashi, Isekai de Dorei ni Sarechaimashita (Naki) Shikamo Goshujin-sama wa Seikaku no Warui Elf no Joou-sama (demo Chou Bijin ← Koko Daiji) Munou Sugite Nonoshiraremakuru kedo Douryou no Orc ga Iyashikei da shi Sato no Elf wa Kawaii shi

177565.description:
In the year Showa 10, a strange friendship is born between Akihiko, a boy who dreams of becoming a doctor, and Hisao, a girl with a prosthetic hand, when they meet at a medical exhibition. However, every time Hisao meets Akihiko, Hisao's body deteriorates as parts are replaced by prosthetics...... This retro science fiction drama is full of darkness and beauty, questioning the nature of humanity and independence!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Note: Afternoon Shiki-sho award winner for Spring 2024.

177566.description:
Mika, a first-year high school girl, is unable to go to cram school due to family circumstances. Still hoping to get into her dream school, she asks Rippiyo, a girl with good grades even without cram school, to show her how to study on her own. The two of them will study together to prepare for their college entrance exams...?

(Source: Young Jump, translated)

title.native: 勉強はきっとウチらに平等だ！
title.romaji: Benkyou wa Kitto Uchira ni Byoudouda!

177567.description:
The diverging paths between students on the science track and the humanities track.

Note: Winner of the Jade Prize in the 30th Yuri-Hime Manga Awards. Published in the June 2024 issue of Comic Yuri-Hime.

title.native: 文系のきみ、理系のあなた
title.romaji: Bunkei no Kimi, Rikei no Anata

177568.description:
At this girls' school, all disputes are resolved with rap battles.

Note: Published in the Spring issue of Jump SQ Rise.

177569.description:
When the handsome boy from the next class suddenly confesses to Nagatsuki, a girl who lacks confidence in herself, they decide to go out for one date on a trial basis.

Note: Published in the June 2024 issue of Dessert Pink supplemental.

title.native: こんな出会いイベ、わたしに起こるわけがない！
title.romaji: Konna Deai Ibe, Watashi ni Okoru Wake ga Nai!

177570.description:
A quiet girl joins the cheer squad to support Kazuma-kun, a sunny and outgoing boy.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

Note: Winner of the Excellence Prize in the 53rd Dessert Newcomer Manga Award. Published in the October 2023 issue of Dessert Blue supplemental.

title.romaji: Koe Takaku Kimi to Aeta Aki

177571.description:
Twenty-eight-year-old Shiho tries best to look like a successful "career woman" at work every day. Shiho has no interest in Miyagi, the handsome playboy, who sits next to her and flirts with the other female employees who surround him. One day, however, when Shiho is feeling down, Miyagi gently cuddles up to her. Shiho's heart flutters involuntarily, but at that moment, Miyagi's character changes drastically! With a fierce smile, he comes at her and says, "I'll make you fall for me...!"

(Source: Berry's Bunko, translated)
synonyms: He likes playing tricks on me

title.native: 腹黒御曹司がイジワルです
ハッピー・ヘヴンズ・シティライフ！
ほうしょうぶしゃくらいいこ

177579.description:
Kaede, a high school student, has won first place in an art contest with a painting of her favorite food, basashi. The painting was hung up at her school, making her instantly become the talk of the town. Even the scary-looking boy, Satomi, has taken notice of her work. Satomi actually has a secret he can't tell anyone…! Could basashi really be the thing that brings these two together?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.english: I’m So Hungry I Could Eat Basashi

177582.description: In 19th-century Venice, a Vatican knight saint wearing a wolf mask investigates incidents caused by mysterious masks. But he has a purpose: the man has lost his face and is looking for the mask that might help him find it again.

177584.description:
In this world, is where the magical world of “Holocas World” exists, created when the light of people's hearts, “Holo” is gathered through the “Holocas” streaming app. The six protagonists: Kanata, Miko, Luna, Shion, Chloe, and Marine are usually active as “Holocas” streamers.

The “Yumeochi” phenomenon occurs when people who are anxious or stressed in their daily lives and have lost their positive attitude are sucked into the “Holocas World” with their souls. The “Collapser” monsters are birthed by a build-up of “Yumeochi". In order to defeat a "Collapser", these streamers are given the power to transform into magical girls called “holoWitches” and spend their days fighting to defeat Collapsers and save those who have fallen into a "Yumeochi" state.

What is “Yumeochi”? The story of these magical girls who fight against the dark forces and bring dreams and hope to people begins.

(Source: Magical Girl holoWitches! Site, translated and edited)

Note: The manga is composed of two parts: the first has 31 chapters, and the second has a total of 23 chapters.

title.native: 魔法少女ホロウィッチ！

177585.description:
1. Henrietta (アンリエッタ)
2. Flemingke no Higeki (フレミング家の悲劇)
3. Tobidase! Lucy (とびだせ! ルーシー)
4. Elliot no Bourei (エリオットの亡霊)
5. Kagami no Naka no Marii (鏡の中のマリイ)
6. Koi wo Sagasou! (恋をさがそう!)
7. Computer-chan (こんぴゅうたぁちゃん)

177586.description:
"I knew who that person was at a glance."

One day, on her way to work, Sayuri Terazono, suddenly spots an all too familiar back in the crowd of people before her. Though many years had passed since she last saw Lisa, there's no way Sayuri would be able to forget her precious Kohai. After all, Lisa wasn't just any Kohai for Sayuri, she was special.

But, there's no way Lisa would remember her after all this time, right?

Or does she...

(Source: Digital Manga Publishing)

177587.description:
The year is 2020. Brain-computer interfaces leading to more realistic virtual experiences have been developed. While initially driven by gaming, virtual reality has made its way to other industries. One such industry is psychotherapy, which utilizes the virtual reality game Dream World. Psychology graduate student Wan Youxi is one of Dream World's players. Her mother was one of the game's developers, but died a bizarre death after finishing the game. Wan Youxi dives into the game to search for clues and comes across her neighbor, Xie Zhehan, a high-level player. She realizes that the game is no longer the same as it once was. A disturbing air lingers in the game. PVP players become highly aggressive and develop mental illnesses. Missions leave players susceptible to hypnosis...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

177588.description:
Have you ever wondered where people who disappeared go? University student Su Anni accidentally fell into a crack in space-time and found herself in a dangerous and illogical land. In that place, she has to stay alive and find out what happened. Who will survive the place where time has stopped and space-time doesn't work like how it’s supposed to as everyone fights to their death?! Who will work together in Chaos Lands?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

177589.description:
Chu Qitong thought that she would spend her whole life in the palace plotting shady schemes, until she met Ning Zhuangyan. That girl in the red dress broke into her heart like a ray of light from the scorching sun, and she realized that in this world, love can be more important than power.

Chu Qitong: In the past, I schemed to help win the throne for Aze, but now everything I do is so you can live a peaceful life.

Ning Zhuangyan: My sweetheart is the most beautiful woman in the kingdom. She can't buy me jewels and gowns, and she won't be taking me away on a high horse. But on that day at the Golden Luan Hall, when she took my hand with all eyes on her, I realized that she meant more to me than any man in this world.

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

title.romaji: Nai He Gongzhu Tai Fu Hei

177590.description:
Kuga, a handsome but perverted teacher, confesses his love to his student, Naruse, who lives a carefree life. Without thinking much about it, Naruse has sex with his teacher. When they sleep together for a second time, Kuga begins to show his true colors. Although Naruse is disgusted by his teacher, he cannot escape Kuga's pleasures...

(Source: DLSite)

177591.description:
In a world devastated by numerous battles with demons, the brutal adventure story of modern adventurer Johan begins! A full-fledged dark fantasy spun through magic begins!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: イマドキのサバサバ冒険者

177592.description:
1. Miboujin Midara Ochi (未亡人淫ら堕ち)
2. Saimin Cosplay Choukyou Club (催眠コスプレ調教クラブ); ANGEL Club 2018-12
3. (ハメ嬲り祭の夜)
4. Akogare no Kanojo wa Midara ni Warau (憧れの彼女は淫らに哂う)
5. Mesu Kyoushi Biyaku Chigoku (牝教師媚薬痴獄)
6. (性奴隸嬢 紗弥の淫鬱)
7. Yariman Gal wa H ga Shitai (ヤリマンギャルはHがシたいっ!)
8. Ninpu Kyouhaku Kyousei Chigoku (妊婦脅迫強制恥獄); ANGEL Club 2018-01
9. Comic's Tokubetsu (コミックス特別); Kakioroshi

177593.description: On August 8, 1961, China mourned the death of one of its most popular artists: Mei Lanfang. This singer of the Beijing Opera, who moved various audiences to tears with his interpretations of female roles, began his career in 1904 at the age of ten. For hours on end, he trained his voice, learned dance, and rehearsed acrobatics until reaching a level of refinement that propelled him not only in China but also onto the international stage. Yin Ling delicately traces the life and career of this extraordinary figure, offering us a glimpse into the magical and lesser-known world of the Beijing Opera.
synonyms: Mei Lanfang : Une vie à l'opéra de Pékin

177594.description:
Yuri Onagawa (male) is unable to forget his first love, Kyoko-chan. He is about to give up on his crush when he discovers that Kyoko hates men. One day, when he prays for love at a shrine, a mysterious power transforms him into a girl...?

(Source: Shueisha, translated)
synonyms: I'm a GIRL in love with the girl

177595.description:
Once upon a time, Iris' greatest challenge as a socially inept mage was receiving the occasional client at her workshop. Little did she know that the nasty woman knocking on her door would change that forever. One violent confrontation later, the two women end up switching bodies-- and as it turns out, Iris' new body belongs to the kingdom's infamous shrew, Queen Rosemary! With her original body damaged and the real Rosemary dead, Iris must continue living as the queen. But that's easier said than done when the entire royal court hates her, especially her fiery husband the king... who Rosemary was conveniently plotting to dethrone with the help of her many lovers. Needless to say, Iris is woefully unprepared for the deadliest "ball" of her life, and not just because she's a terrible dancer. All she can do is pray that the moon will guide her through these hopelessly dark times!

Of course, it helps that her new boss, Bong-Su, is easy on the eyes. Will Seol prove to the hot farmer that she has what it takes? Will she win the respect of her family? Most importantly, how will she keep from falling in love with Bong-Su?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Does she have a screw loose?

He also has a supernatural ability to see souls, which are sometimes tied to these objects. Trying not to reveal his ability, he secretly helps friends and people around him fix their broken stuff.

Due to his abilities, Seong-U soon finds himself surrounded by numerous ancient people/souls who help him fix things or solve difficult matters. And the more restoration projects and their related pieces of stuff he takes on, the more interesting his life becomes. But sudden visits from his missing father's graduate school advisor and a cute girl from an ancient Korean Kingdom will soon make the world know his unique skills...whether he wants it or not!

A vivid memory from 10 years ago comes back to him. But there's a huge distance between Naoharu, shining in the light of the stage, and Sora, standing in the audience... Determined to make a living somehow, he resorts to hitman work, only to wake up after a mission gone wrong at the mercy of a mysterious beast. Yet, in an unexpected turn of events, this wolf-like man offers Eun-Gyeol an unbelievable amount of money to change the target of his hit…to none other than the man’s own father. Armed with nothing but tenacity, Eun-Gyeol sets out on a tumultuous journey with a lone wolf by his side.

(Source: Lezhin US)

177649.description:
Min-Chan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter. What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Min-Chan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Tae-Wook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega. Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Min-Chan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Tae-Wook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore. Then one night, fate strikes: Tae-Wook enters his heat cycle, and Min-Chan doesn’t miss his chance. Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—

In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Min-Chan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

While begrudgingly playing babysitter to the pretty and pampered Lily, an unexpected rut strikes. “I'm just trying to save his life. There's nothing more to it.” But as the lines blur between duty and desire, Jess and Lily discover they might be the perfect match in more ways than one."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tsuwabuki, a lion-dog, is forced by his sister to take on the sacrificial role of healing a weakened god. He ends up becoming the dragon god's bride, and...?!

177656.description:
Han Soo-Ah grew up with everything a girl could need. Or so she thought, until she realized she was no more than a tool at her father’s disposal. The best she could do for herself was live up to the expectations that sat heavy on her shoulders. She’s resigned herself to such a life, until a fateful encounter in a music store changes things forever. Will the man at the piano be able to restore what Soo-Ah doesn’t even know she has lost…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

177657.description:
Oh Dok-Hee, the drummer of Bold Rabbit, an indie band on the verge of breaking out, is offered a high-profile photoshoot. Initially hesitant and shy in front of the camera, he agrees when he learns that the photographer is Myung Lee-Jin, someone Dok-Hee has admired for years.

What begins as a simple photoshoot quickly spirals into confusion when Lee-Jin misunderstands Dok-Hee. In an attempt to clear things up, Dok-Hee seduces him into intercourse. As the lines between desire and misunderstanding blur, Dok-Hee finds himself entangled in emotions he can barely control.

Will Dok-Hee’s hidden love finally reach Lee-Jin, or will everything unravel before it even begins?

(Source: Lezhin US)

177658.description:
When Shinhu Ki, the youngest prince of the Underworld, was tasked with guiding 30,000 spirits to the land of the dead, he figured it would be a breeze. Three years later, he’s barely made any progress until he meets Hajoon Yeon, who not only seems to be a lure for the spirits but is also full of yin, the source of Shinhu’s power. In exchange for helping Hajoon’s sick mother, the two enter into a contract where Shinhu can harvest that power anytime, anywhere he wants. And he wants a lot of it…

(Source: Tapas)

177659.description:
A strange and mysterious boy who became a guardian angel to a girl born with an unfortunate fate. Family discord, bullying at school, failure to enter college, and even a broken heart... Sena's series of misfortunes eventually led her to make an extreme choice. It is then that she gains hope for a new life thanks to her guardian angel who appears before her. Even after her new life, she is tormented by the same nightmares every day due to her unforgettable pain, but she lives proudly, taking advantage of her own abilities, which she thought were a curse, and goes to the university she was looking forward to, where she meets her ex-boyfriend. The moment she falls into despair, her guardian angel appears again.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: You are my, I am your guardian angel

177661.description:
After a disastrous office romance, Hyojun quits his job in a fit of rage and opens a café…only to find himself serving more dust than drinks. Business is dead, and desperation sets in; with no other option, he decides to sell the matching couple ring from his ex. The sale goes through quickly, but on the day of the meetup, something unexpected happens: the café is suddenly packed. It turns out the buyer is a stunningly handsome student, and word of his looks has drawn a crowd. Watching people fawn over the mystery heartthrob, Hyojun makes a snap decision that will change his life forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

177662.description:
Mugi Hinata has had a physical relationship with Suku Oumi, a popular professional Go player, since their school days. They can only meet when in heat and have yet to become lovers. Even so, they are happy just to be together. Then one day, he witnesses shocking news about Oumi...?

(Source: Fusion Product, translated)

177663.description:
Since ancient times, fairies have existed to maintain balance in the world, each governing a fundamental human desire - wealth, pleasure, appetite, rest, and honor. Pence, a money fairy with an insatiable thirst for riches, was poised to become the next ruler of the fairy realm. But his greed came at a cost. When he exploits his powers at the expense of others, he is cast out and stripped of his status, forced to live among humans. Now stranded in the mortal world, Pence crosses paths with Yoo-Jin, a relentless workaholic struggling to make ends meet. But old habits die hard, and Pence's schemes for easy wealth quickly backfire. As karma catches up to him, he’s about to learn the true cost of greed—and what it really means to earn one’s fortune.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

177664.description:
Lee Yoonsung and Park Dokyung grew up together in the countryside since they were young. Yoonsung became an actor by chance, but whenever he has time, he travels back and forth between Seoul and his hometown to see Dokyung, his first and unrequited love.

Dokyung cared for Yoonsung, who had cried a lot since he was young. Yoonsung finds himself developing stronger feelings for Dokyung, and his body's responses are becoming more noticeable. Fearing that his feelings would be exposed, Yoonsung tries not to show and resolves to remain at least a friend...

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

177666.description:
Pop star Subaru Isshiki is saved by legendary musician Ren Shishido after he's cornered by a stalker in an alleyway. Ren finds himself attracted to Subaru, who is one of his biggest fans. Ren tells Subaru he's free to follow him back to his place. Not wanting to miss his chance to get closer to Ren, Subaru follows him. Once there, Ren tells Subaru to go sit anywhere in his bedroom. Subaru patiently waits on Ren's bed when Ren leans over to kiss him and then takes his shirt off! The two share an unforgettable night together, but Subaru takes his leave the next day expecting to never see Ren again. However, Subaru finds himself in another situation where Ren helps him out and their relationship takes a new turn.

(Source: Renta!)

177668.description:
Toma Sugawa is a cool-headed, unsociable businessman. For some reason, he's not in a relationship, and he spends his life watching the days go by. One thing that has become a part of his daily routine, is waking up one of the tenants in his grandfather's apartment complex. That tenant is Kaoru Aida. He has countless alarms go off, and still doesn't wake up until Toma comes in to wake him. On top of that, he asks Toma to wake him up the next morning, without a lick of remorse. With an attitude like that, of course Toma is on the verge of snapping. But one day, Toma goes to wake him up as usual, and Kaoru, still sleepy, pushes him down?! Enjoy this clumsy, blooming love story between an inconsiderate guy and a guy still stuck on his ex!

(Source: MangaPlaza)

177670.description:
Kippei is always doting on and showing his affection for Munechika. He tousles his hair, feeds him snacks, and gives him secret kisses in the hallway... Everyone is afraid of Munechika's demeanor, but Kippei finds him cute and adorable. Kippei even studied like crazy just to get into the same college as Munechika. But then one day, Munechika suddenly starts acting cold towards Kippei...?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

177673.description:
Daughter of a deposed baron, Becky is sold by her father to the Archduchess Vernum. Arriving at her new masters, she becomes friends with Princess Liande, as beautiful as she is surly. But as the two young women grow inexorably closer, a question from Liande will cause trouble for Becky: “What would you say, if I were a man?”

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)

177674.description:
The time is the Heian Era. Tomoe is only interested in otaku things, and she is shy around people. So her favorite companions are the otaku youkai in nature. But when she learns that a famed doujinshi will be on display, she summons up all her courage and heads for the event at the palace. But unfortunately, a major incident occurs! The one who rescues Tomoe is Kiminto, an onmyoji… A story of new friendship full of moe and thrills!

(Source: Libre, translated)

177675.description:
Lily’s family chose to sacrifice her freedom, but the infamous Duke Blake has set a trap to ensnare her heart instead. Lily is sent to the duke’s estate like an innocent lamb for slaughter...although Lily’s love already belongs to a handmaid named Anna. At the estate, an uneasiness gnaws at her mind...is there anyone in the world who truly loves her back?

(Source: Tapas)

Haruichi Azuma, who was orphaned as a child after losing his parents in an accident, was treated poorly all his life by relatives who took him in. He was living a difficult life. One day, an old friend of his father's invites him to his house to be a "caretaker for his daughter." However, what was waiting for him was Tsubaki, the second daughter of the Yaotome family, who has a selfish and arrogant attitude. With the press of a button, Yu Sol’s life is about to turn upside down. When a mysterious post with the power to transport the user to their favorite fictional universe pops up on his feed, Sol clicks “share” and falls asleep…only to awake the next day as a round, winged puffball! Try to speak as he might, he can only mutter one word- er, sound: “Peep!” With his new avian appearance, Sol must navigate the land of Sevon under the guiding hand of his new (strikingly handsome) owner, Karhan Barthés, while trying to find a way back to world from which he came.

(Soure: Lezhin US)

I met a devilish man in the mansion where I moved in as a helper as if running away from violence and looting. And suddenly, a strange whistling sound is heard. The watcher's gaze towards me and the strange rituals gradually catch my breath.

177768.description: Minamino Kaze is a soccer prodigy, yet prefers to spend his days training intensely by the beach to actually joining his high school team. With memories of his late brother's intense work ethic and superhuman skill driving him on, can Kaze achieve his dream of becoming a soccer legend? 17 volumes of hot-blooded soccer action!

177770.description:
Mizuki has been depressed after his mother’s death. One day, Misaki, an off-season transfer student, arrives. Misaki joins the library comittee and she helps Mizuki at the library after school. As they grow closer, Misaki suddenly reveals that her life expectancy is short.

“Before I die, I want you to help me with everything I want to do.”

Mizuki makes every effort, for her sake, but Misaki still has one more hidden secret. The shy Mizuki and the innocent Misaki. A pure love story with a time limit.

(Source: Novema, translated)

177771.description:
Tomoaki has given up on his dream of becoming an illustrator and is leading an uneventful life at school, until Nanami transfers in one day. Nanami is a big fan of Tomoaki's grandfather, who was a famous picture book illustrator, and she hopes to author a picture book of her own some day. Nanami finds out that Tomoaki had illustrated picture books in the past and she invites him to create a picture book together. At first, Tomoaki refuses, but Nanami's earnest enthusiasms tempts him. When Tomoaki learns that Nanami has only six months left to live, he decides that he will do everything he can to help make Nanami's dream come true. Tomoaki had left his dream behind, and Nanami is still pursuing hers. This is a love story of two people trying to make the same dream come true from opposite directions.

(Source: Novema, translated)

177773.description:
"Looks like our class president has a date."

Kwak Woo-Chan hears the rumors about the Kwon Da-ro, the teachers' favorite as the best student in the whole school, who has had no signs any romantic interest in the past. Kwon Da-Ro has been his best friend since he was 12 years old, but he didn't know anything about a date, but the evidence is visible to all as a "hickey under the ear"?! Surprisingly, the culprit behind the pink marks on the nape of his neck is Woo-Chan.

"The red dot has been passed down through generations in the Kwak family, like a seal of the heart, imprinted on the person you like. So Kwak Woo-chan, do you like me?”

He's been caught, by his unrequited love of 7 years.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

177774.description:
Set in a World War 2-inspired war-torn dark fantasy world where various countries are involved in a seemingly endless war. Some people have the ability to create all kind of weapons in their bodies. One particular boy is forced to create weapons in order to protect his sister. But when he finds out that she's been sold by his captors, he loses his mind and his whole body turns into a deadly human weapon determined to erase everything.

Note: Winner of the Tsudzuki wo Yoma Sero Grand Prix, for the chance to be serialized on Yanmaga Web.

177775.description:
I was originally the apex predator that stood at the top of the world—the legendary red dragon. For thousands of years, my countless brethren have been murdered by humans, and revenge slowly turned into my only reason for living!In the end, however, I failed. On the day of the final battle with the humans, I was slain, and died with vengeance burning in my heart...If there were another life, I would definitely avenge my kind!If there were another life, I would make those filthy humans pay for what they've done!If there were another life... Huh?I got reincarnated as a feeble human child?!

(Source: Webnovel)

Same scenery, same everyday... A rural girls' school is idyllic, peaceful, and boring. Ichikawa is an art teacher who is very popular with the girls at the school because of his refreshing smile. Why has he come to such a rural area? Because it's the best hunting ground. Girls are simple, easy, and cute, and he's going to… with a female student today, too!? The next target is Ria Koda. Even if she says no at first… the feeling of defiling a pure white canvas is irresistible!

"I'm tired of holding back."

What kind of debauchery will Ria choose next…?

(Source: &Flower, translated)

Machida falls in love with Kitayama, a senior who makes her laugh. Machida confesses her feelings to Kitayama, but Kitayama quickly rejects her, telling her that she already has a boyfriend who aspires to be a comedian. Trying to impress Kitayama, Machida becomes a comedian herself, but she is unsuccessful, until one day when she runs into Kitayama again...?

177784.description:
I have a steady live-in boyfriend. His name is Tatsuma.

But lately Tatsuma has been cold. He always comes home late and eats his meals out....... I was wondering if this is because I'm not good at sex and I can't satisfy Tatsuma. I was doubting myself and feeling lonely.

One day, I went to a drinking party at Makishima-kun's house, who was our friend in college. Tatsuma didn't come because he had something to do at work. Trying to have a good time, I drank a bit more alcohol than usual, and I talked a bit too much. I even complained a little about Tatsuma… but everyone listened and laughed it off as a joke. Makishima-kun was the only one who took my problems seriously. After everyone had fallen asleep, he thoughtfully listened to me and Tatsuma's sexless problem without making fun of me.

"I like both of you and Tatsuma, so I want you to stay with each other. It would be sad if you break up because of that, even though you are a good match for each other."

He offers to help me "practice feeling arousal" so I could become a better lover, but—

(Source: DLSite, translated)

Office worker Kaname can't stand his coworker Shinonome, but when a work-related circumstance arises, they find themselves unthinkably entering into a one-year contract marriage?! Expecting the worst, Kaname and Shinonome try to cohabitate, however, after an extended argument, they kiss, in the heat of the moment, and both become extremely aroused! What will happen when the company's famous duo crosses the line on their first day of marriage?!

(Source: Coolmic)

177792.description:
"Are you tired? Want to massage my chest?"

A wealthy oil magnate discoves an unexpected treasure--his chest?! Shams, the heir to an oil empire, decides to broaden his horizens by studying abroad in Japan. He hires Taiyo, a struggling student, to be his caretaker. However, Sham finds himsef captivated by Taiyo's radiant smile, which glimmers like an oasis. Feelings gush forth like an oil field! That is when Shams learns that his chest has the power to heal and bring fortune…! Thus begins the heartwarming tale of a pure-hearted billioniare and a hardworking troubled young man! With Shams's caramel-toned skin, huge chest, and unwavering love, both heart and loins are on the verge of exploding!!

(Source: Coolmic)

177793.description:
"Repeat another year as a child, or let me have my way with you and become an adult!"

Takeo, a troubled youth frequently caught up in fights, finds himself paired with the Student Council President, Yushi. Yushi was assigned to be his watch dog and tasked with trying to keep him out of trouble. Despite Takeo being famous for being a deliquent, Yushi treats him with kindess. Takeo finds himself drawn toward the Student Council President's charm and compassion. Just as Takeo is about to be overwhelmed in a fight, Yushi cames in to break it up. Yushi teases him, "It's about time I made you into an adult..." Now the Student Council Present that Takeo had secretly admired was right on top of him...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

One year after the battle with Glenn, Köinzell—now serving as Viceroy Ascheriit within the Imperial Army led by Empress Elsaria—is deployed to quell the rebellions that continue to plague the realm. Alongside him, Commander in Chief Geranpen, Chief Consul Aht, and Blatt Meister Ichfeis join forces to defend the Empire and support Elsaria. Through it all, in the remote southern territory of Helenirdo, a resistance group calling themselves the Knights of the Fallen King, who believe in Glenn’s resurrection, begins to move in the shadows. The fates of Köinzell and the Seven Heroes have once again become inextricably intertwined…

177821.description:
Sota Kitaoka, born in Shizunai, Hokkaido, to a family that ran a restaurant called "Kitaoka", moved to Tokyo for training in order to rebuild his family's run-down restaurant. There, he was discovered by the owner of "Tomikyu," a long-established ryotei restaurant in Ginza, where he underwent rigorous training, eventually becoming the head chef at Tomikyu. After that, he went on a culinary journey until he opened his own restaurant, "Tomikyu Kamui" in Nerima, Tokyo.

A few years later, Sota is back at it again, this time to pursue the essence of "Omotenashi" (hospitality), just in time for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics! The long-awaited revival of the classic culinary manga!

(Source: Bunkasha, translated)

177823.description:
On a bloody battlefield, the master swordsman Rix finally gives in to his deep-seated dislike for warfare. So he fakes his own death to go into retirement! He starts fresh by entering a magic school...despite his magical aptitude being zero. However, alongside the scholarship student Shino, he's ready to work hard. Even her cold attitude doesn't discourage him! Using his swordsmanship prowess, he overpowers his magic-wielding peers-inadvertently smashing through anything that's common practice at magic school. In the process, his skills catch the eye of the Imperial princess. She tries to recruit him into the army, but he shoots her down. He doesn't want to be the strongest— all he wants is to live a peaceful and enjoyable life!

(Source: Yen Press)

Recently, Maruo has become concerned about Tabe, a girl who is always scarred and bullied. He wants to help her, but is afraid of being bullied himself. What's more, Tabe is also the target of voyeurism, causing Maruo to feel a sense of self-loathing.

177828.description:
In high school, Shiraishi would tease her classmate Arashi by constantly touching his shaved head. Now, many years later, Shiraishi finds herself enthralled with a rising star that she sees on TV and in magazines. That celebrity being none other that Arashi, her former classmate, but now with long grown-out hair. She goes about her life, hoping that some day she might meet him again and tell him all the things that she's kept in her heart for so many years. A tale of lost opportunities and a love separated by time...
